scope: unique operation, evidence, transformation, execution, and finding IDs

preferred_attempt.method: fresh clone and retained validator execution

fallback.method: connector-backed exact-file structural inspection against the retained validator profile
fallback.reason_not_executed: the local environment could not acquire the repository because GitHub DNS resolution failed

proof_limits: The fallback proves connector-backed structural consistency at the reviewed file set; it is not an executed clean-checkout validator result.
It does not prove installation, tests, or reports reproduce from a clean local checkout.
It does not prove external truth, absolute compatibility, or update safety.
It does not establish production schema fitness, automation reliability, or Ali-owned capability.
A future environment with working GitHub access should run the retained validator from a clean checkout when useful.
